floral_infrastructure_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Heavy-duty structural elements including Sunflower mounts, Tulip terminals, and Rose-Thorn hooks (Plate 1). Capped at a strict 3.5mm3/s volumetric flow speed backed by a 15mm prime pillar loop to maintain perfectly uniform internal nozzle pressure across varying geometries, entirely preventing spline under-extrusion or structural tooth brittleness.

sanitary_pouches_soft_tpu_85a.structural_purpose: Flexible wall storage units and flat-printed caddy grip sleeve bands (Plate 3). Sliced in soft 85A TPU with an expanded -0.30mm horizontal contour clearance override to completely neutralize rubber thermal die-swell, ensuring the male T-splines slide into the rigid organizer channels smoothly without sticking friction.

meal_prep_containers_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: Hydrophobic food-contact elements and rigid organizer frames (Plate 2). Sliced in high-shrinkage Polypropylene (PP). Enforces a 10mm solid brim at a perfect zero-gap offset combined with 0% print fan cooling to lock the base down flat against plate warping. Applies a +0.12mm hole compensation override to neutralize PP's 2% crystallization shrinkage, keeping internal female T-slots perfectly spec-aligned to receive the separate TPU grip linings. Appends a high-velocity auxiliary fan end-script to rapidly flash-cool living hinges into a permanently flexible, non-brittle state.
